title: ai-dev-kit project adapter
description: Per-project parameters read by ai-dev-kit skills at run time. Every field is optional — a skill missing a field derives it from the repo (and says so) rather than failing.

projectType.description: Dispatches skills' per-domain reference procedures (e.g. live-verify reads references/<type>.md). Absent → skills infer the type from the repo (manifests, engine project files) and say so.

ecosystem.description: Language/registry facts dep-check and friends read. Supersedes packageManager for non-JS projects; both may coexist.

runtime.description: Primary runtime/toolchain, free string: node · python · rust · go · dotnet · jvm · unity · unreal · godot · …

manifestFiles.description: Dependency manifests to watch (package.json, pyproject.toml, Cargo.toml, go.mod, *.csproj, packages.config, …).

registryQuery.description: Command template printing published versions/dates for {pkg} (e.g. `npm view {pkg} versions --json`, `pip index versions {pkg}`, `cargo search {pkg} --limit 1`).

addCommand.description: Command template adding {pkg} at {version} per the project's package manager.

packageManager.description: v1 (JS-only) — prefer `ecosystem.*` for new adapters; still honored. Shapes registry queries and script invocations.

gate.description: Commands, run in order, that make up the full verification gate (lint, type-check, build). An array — never a '&&' chain — so it runs on any shell.

verify.description: How live-verify runs the built artifact and observes it — any project shape (server, game, CLI, library, pipeline). Supersedes prodVerify (still honored; skills read verify first and fall back).

run.description: Runs the artifact: serve on the dedicated port, headless engine scene, CLI invocation, consumer-harness import, sample pipeline slice.

ready.description: How the skill knows the run is up / done and healthy.

port.description: For http/tcp-port: the dedicated verify port (never the dev port).

observe.description: Commands or flow descriptions that exercise changed behavior and produce observable output (curl the endpoint, run the golden-output case, load the test scene).

notes.description: Env/origin/seed facts an agent needs before driving flows.

prodVerify.description: v1 (server-shaped) — prefer `verify` for new adapters; still honored as the fallback. How live-verify serves a production build without disturbing a standing dev server.

start.description: Serves the production build on the dedicated port.

port.description: Dedicated prod-verify port (never the dev port).

notes.description: Env/origin facts an agent needs before driving flows.

cache.description: The local build cache that grows without bound, and how to measure/prune it.

backlogHuman.description: Optional second backlog for human-blocked rows (needs a verdict, hardware, or account only the user has). Pairs with `backlog` (the agent-continuable track) — projects running the dual-track split keep 'never both blocked at once' as the working rule.

contextDir.description: Agent context docs, loaded on demand.

archiveDir.description: Where audit reports and archived history land.

handoff.description: Where checkpoint writes the resume/handoff file. Absent → the agent memory directory (resume-prompt.md). Keep repo paths out of version control unless deliberately tracked.

contextBudget.description: Line/token budgets for the always-loaded and on-demand context surfaces, read by doc-audit's standing-instruction hunt. Heuristics — the audit flags and recommends, never hard-fails.

contextDocSplitTokens.description: A context doc above this size (tokens ≈ chars/4) is flagged for split/index (default 3000).

memoryIndexMaxTokens.description: Ceiling for the always-loaded memory index (default 700).

skillDescriptionMaxTokens.description: Combined ceiling for all always-loaded skill descriptions (frontmatter `description:` lines load every session). doc-audit flags when the installed set exceeds it.

enforcement.description: Opt-in blocking hooks. The handlers ship (and may be wired) with every install but each no-ops unless its key is set here — absent key = advise-only kit behavior, unchanged.

stopGate.description: Stop-hook gate: the session may not end with these commands failing (exit 2 feeds failures back). Loop-guarded via stop_hook_active; skips before dependencies are installed.

commands.description: Commands run in order at session end (e.g. a fast typecheck + unit-test pair — keep it under ~2 minutes).

bannedApis.description: Path-scoped banned-pattern guards (the determinism-guard pattern generalized): each entry blocks listed regex patterns from entering files under its paths.

name.description: Label used in the block message.

paths.description: Repo-relative directory prefixes the guard watches.

excludePaths.description: Repo-relative files/prefixes exempt from the guard.

pattern.description: JS regex source matched per line (comments stripped first).

why.description: Shown in the block message — what to use instead.

docs.description: Doc path cited in the block message.

checkpointAutorun.description: true = the Stop hook nudges one autonomous checkpoint turn when the tree is dirty or unpushed at session end (skips mid-rebase/merge and pending-question stops).

trailers.description: false = never add Co-Authored-By or other trailers.

useFileFlag.description: true = write the message to a file and use git commit -F (survives PowerShell 5.1 quoting).

workflow.description: The workflow to watch to green at a session-ending checkpoint.

devPorts.description: Ports where orphaned dev/prod servers may linger.

e2eUserPattern.description: Email pattern identifying throwaway e2e users in the local DB.

keepContainers.description: Docker containers tidy must never prune.

releaseAgeDays.description: Prefer the newest version at least this many days old.

exactPin.description: Packages that publish frequently — always pin exact.

harnessAudit.description: Parameters read by the harness-audit skill.

kitSourcePath.description: Local clone of ai-dev-kit to mirror harness-audit's sources.md/stack.md repairs into, if this machine has one.

init.description: Project-inception parameters read by the project-init (greenfield) and project-adopt (brownfield) skills.

scaffold.description: Mechanical scaffold command run at intake (env seed, rename, template-doc slim). `{name}` is replaced with a lowercase npm-safe slug of the chosen app name (scaffolds may silently skip renaming on an invalid npm name); omit the placeholder if the command takes none. Both inception skills confirm before running any scaffold that removes files.

productBrief.description: Where the converged product brief lands (default docs/PRODUCT.md).

migrationMap.description: Where project-adopt's migration map lands — disposition table, parity contract, data/user plan (default docs/MIGRATION.md).

sourceDir.description: Drop-dir convention where an existing codebase is placed for project-adopt when no path/URL argument is given (default intake/source/). Kept gitignored — the original source is a read-only reference, never committed to the adopting repo's history.
